mission_06: Spectral subtraction computes clean magnitude as sqrt(max(|noisy|^2 - alpha * |noise|^2, 0)) and applies a spectral floor to prevent musical noise.
The Wiener filter gain at each frequency is S / (S + N), where S is the estimated signal power and N is the noise power.
SNR in decibels is computed as 10 * log10(signal_power / noise_power), and noise is scaled to achieve the target SNR by multiplying by sqrt(desired_noise_var / actual_noise_var).
